svg.title: Qara-Chik Demarcation Line
svg.desc: The 2007 ceasefire line between the ISEZ and the Autonomous Tribal Regions, with its four UNMI sectors, the 12 km restricted-weapons zone, the main crossing and UN headquarters. Base map: Natural Earth (public domain).
